distinctness: Canonical rendered mathematical claim sets, ignoring statement/choice order, wording, seed, identities, template aliases and equivalent lattice spellings. Existing source and canonical content always excluded from newly generated content.

exceptions.action: Preserve unchanged; generator uses supported authored assignments for genuinely distinct new content. Legacy unclassified scheduler job may remain.

exhaustion_policy: Exhaust the finite permitted parameter domain if seeded sampling cannot meet a requested reserve; record remaining shortage rather than padding duplicates.
